title: Why the query planner ignores your index
text: PostgreSQL skips an index when it estimates that a sequential scan reads fewer pages, which happens with low-selectivity predicates or stale statistics. Run ANALYZE after bulk loads and check the plan with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) before adding more indexes.

title: Connection pooling with PgBouncer
text: Each PostgreSQL connection is a separate backend process that uses several megabytes of memory. Put PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode in front of the database so hundreds of short-lived application connections share a few dozen server connections.

title: Choosing between B-tree and GIN indexes
text: B-tree indexes serve equality and range lookups on scalar columns. GIN indexes map each element of a composite value, such as the words in a tsvector or the keys in a JSONB document, to the rows that contain it, which makes containment queries fast and writes slower.

title: Resolving deadlocks in order processing
text: Two transactions that lock the same rows in opposite order will eventually deadlock, and the database aborts one of them. Update rows in a consistent order, for example sorted by primary key, and keep transactions short.

title: Partitioning a two-billion-row events table
text: We split the events table by month with declarative range partitioning. Old partitions are detached and archived to object storage, queries that filter on the event date touch only the relevant partitions, and vacuum finishes in minutes instead of hours.

title: Read replicas and replication lag
text: Asynchronous streaming replicas can fall seconds behind the primary under heavy write load. Route reads that must see their own writes to the primary, and alert when replay lag exceeds the freshness the product promises.

title: Error E1047: migration lock timeout
text: E1047 means the schema migration tool could not acquire its advisory lock within 30 seconds because another deploy is still migrating. Wait for the other pipeline to finish; never delete the lock row by hand.

title: Caching hot reads with Redis
text: A read-through cache in Redis absorbed 80 percent of product-page lookups. Set a time-to-live on every key and add jitter to expiry times so thousands of keys do not expire at the same moment and stampede the database.

title: Diagnosing intermittent packet loss
text: Run mtr against the destination for at least five minutes and look for loss that persists to the final hop. Loss at a single intermediate router is usually ICMP rate limiting, not a real problem.

title: Why DNS changes take time to propagate
text: Resolvers cache answers for the record's TTL. Lower the TTL a day before a planned migration, switch the record, then raise it again once traffic has moved.

title: TLS handshake failures after certificate renewal
text: Clients rejected the new certificate because the server sent only the leaf and omitted the intermediate certificate. Serve the full chain and verify it with openssl s_client -showcerts.

title: Tuning keep-alive behind HTTP/2 load balancers
text: Idle connections closed by the load balancer before the backend's keep-alive timeout produce sporadic 502 errors. Make the backend's idle timeout longer than the balancer's.

title: Home Wi-Fi drops during video calls
text: Crowded 2.4 GHz channels and band steering can make laptops hop between access points in the middle of a call. Pin the laptop to the 5 GHz network and pick a channel with fewer neighbouring networks.

title: MTU mismatches on VPN tunnels
text: Encapsulation overhead lowers the usable packet size inside a tunnel. When large transfers stall while small requests succeed, clamp the TCP maximum segment size or lower the interface MTU to 1400.

title: Rate limiting at the edge
text: A token-bucket limiter at the API gateway, keyed by client id, absorbed a scraping burst of 40,000 requests per minute without touching the application servers.

title: IPv6 rollout checklist
text: Enable dual-stack on the load balancers first, publish AAAA records last, and make sure firewall rules and logging pipelines parse IPv6 addresses before any customer traffic arrives over it.

title: Rotating leaked API credentials
text: Revoke the exposed key immediately, issue a replacement, then search the access logs for calls made with the old key since the leak. Removing the key from git history does not help once it has been pushed.

title: Phishing-resistant sign-in with passkeys
text: Passkeys bind the credential to the website's origin, so a look-alike domain cannot replay it. We replaced SMS one-time codes with passkeys for all staff accounts.

title: Preventing SQL injection
text: Never build SQL by concatenating user input. Use parameterised queries so the driver sends values separately from the statement text, and give the application's database user only the privileges it needs.

title: Hardening SSH access
text: Disable password authentication, require hardware-backed keys, and expose SSH only through a bastion host with session recording.

title: Triage for dependency vulnerabilities
text: Not every CVE in a transitive dependency is reachable. Check whether the vulnerable function is called from your code before scheduling an emergency upgrade, and record the decision.

title: Secrets baked into container images
text: Build arguments and copied .env files end up in image layers that anyone with pull access can inspect. Mount secrets at runtime from the secret manager instead.

title: Detecting impossible-travel logins
text: Flag a sign-in when the distance from the previous login divided by the elapsed time implies travel faster than an airliner. Combine it with device fingerprints to cut false alarms from VPN users.

title: Least-privilege roles for CI pipelines
text: Give each pipeline its own short-lived role scoped to the resources it deploys, instead of a shared long-lived access key with administrator rights.

title: Detecting data drift in production models
text: Compare the distribution of each input feature in live traffic with the training data using the population stability index, and alert when it crosses 0.2 so the model can be retrained before accuracy degrades.

title: Why validation accuracy beats test accuracy
text: If hyperparameters were tuned against the validation set many times, its score is optimistically biased. Keep a held-out test set that is touched once, at the end.

title: Class imbalance in fraud detection
text: With 0.1 percent positives, accuracy is meaningless. Report precision and recall at the operating threshold, and use class weights or focal loss rather than duplicating minority examples.

title: Hybrid search for the support assistant
text: Keyword search missed paraphrased questions and embedding search missed exact product codes, so we fuse both with reciprocal rank fusion and rerank the top 50 with a cross-encoder.

title: Serving embeddings on CPU
text: A small ONNX sentence-embedding model encodes a short query in about ten milliseconds on a laptop CPU. Batch documents during indexing and quantise vectors to int8 when memory matters more than the last point of recall.

title: Keeping feature stores consistent
text: Training-serving skew appears when offline features are computed with different code from online ones. Generate both from a single feature definition and log the served features for later training.

title: Early stopping and overfitting
text: Stop training when the validation loss has not improved for a set number of epochs, and restore the best checkpoint rather than the last one.

title: Evaluating retrieval with nDCG
text: Normalised discounted cumulative gain rewards putting relevant documents near the top and discounts them logarithmically by rank. Compare systems on the same judged queries.

title: Pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff
text: Kubernetes restarts a container that keeps exiting, with growing back-off delays. Read the previous container's logs with kubectl logs --previous and check whether a missing config value or a failing liveness probe is killing it.

title: Disk full on build agents
text: Old Docker images and build caches fill the agent disk until jobs fail with 'no space left on device'. Prune dangling images nightly and alert at 80 percent usage.

title: Blue-green deployments without downtime
text: Run the new version next to the old one, switch traffic at the load balancer once health checks pass, and keep the old environment warm for a quick rollback.

title: Reducing alert fatigue
text: We deleted alerts nobody acted on and paged only on symptoms users feel, such as error rate and latency against the service level objective. Pages per week fell from 40 to 6.

title: Laptop fans loud and machine slow during builds
text: When the processor runs too hot it lowers its clock speed to protect itself, so compiles take much longer. Clean the vents, use a cooling pad and cap parallel build jobs at the number of physical cores.

title: Memory leaks in long-running services
text: If resident memory grows steadily until the out-of-memory killer restarts the process, capture heap snapshots an hour apart and diff them to find the objects that accumulate.

title: Canary releases with automatic rollback
text: Send five percent of traffic to the new build, compare its error rate and p95 latency with the baseline, and roll back automatically if either worsens beyond the agreed margin.

title: Controlling log retention costs
text: Debug logs kept for a year dominated our observability bill. Sample verbose logs, keep error logs for 90 days and move older archives to cold storage.

title: Slow first page load on mobile
text: Large JavaScript bundles block rendering on mid-range phones. Split code by route, defer non-critical scripts and serve images in modern formats at the size they are displayed.

title: Layout shift from late-loading ads
text: Reserve space for ads and embeds with fixed aspect-ratio containers so the page does not jump when they arrive. This fixed our cumulative layout shift score.

title: Accessible form errors
text: Associate each error message with its input using aria-describedby, move focus to the first invalid field and never rely on colour alone to signal a problem.

title: Debouncing search-as-you-type
text: Firing a request on every keystroke overloaded the search API. Wait 250 milliseconds after the user stops typing and cancel in-flight requests that are no longer needed.

title: Dark mode without a flash of the wrong theme
text: Read the saved preference in a tiny inline script before the stylesheet loads, so the page renders in the right colours from the first frame.

title: Browser caching for static assets
text: Fingerprint file names with a content hash and serve them with a one-year immutable cache header; the HTML itself should revalidate on every visit.

title: Battery drain from background tabs
text: Timers and animations that keep running in hidden tabs wake the CPU and drain laptop batteries. Pause the work when the page visibility changes to hidden.

title: Internationalising dates and numbers
text: Format dates, currencies and plurals with the Intl API in the visitor's locale instead of hand-written patterns, which break for languages such as Arabic and Polish.
